name: Gen.G
headline: LCK 2026 champions (3-1 over HLE, Ruler Finals MVP) and Korea's 1st seed; swept 0-3 by G2 at First Stand and missed MSI after losing 2-3 to T1, so the international record is the open question.

name: T1
adj_reason: Three straight world titles (2023-2025), each won from a non-first domestic seed, so T1's domestic playoff results have under-predicted their Worlds results three years running; 2026 international game record 22-11 versus 9-9 in LCK playoffs. Patch 26.20 buffs Lucian (Peyz's 3rd-most-played champion). Halved to +0.10 in v4 (15/10/2026): pedigree is not a measurement and at +0.20 this single adjustment flipped the T1/HLE order and added 7 points to T1's title odds.
headline: Three-time defending champions in a down domestic year: 3rd in the LCK (9-9 in playoffs), 5th-6th at MSI, 4th at EWC, with Peyz replacing Gumayusi.

name: Hanwha Life Esports
headline: MSI 2026 champions (3-2 over BLG, Zeus Finals MVP) who qualified via that title, then finished LCK runner-up (1-3 to Gen.G twice) with Zeus, Gumayusi and Zeka's big-stage pedigree.

name: Dplus KIA
headline: EWC 2026 champions (BLG 2-1, Gen.G 2-1, KC 3-0) who needed a lower-bracket run for the final Korean seed; youngest LCK roster, ShowMaker the 2020 champion.

name: Bilibili Gaming
adj_reason: Top lane churn all summer: Bin stepped away, Wenbo filled in, Flandre signed 08/08, Bin returned 20/08. Starter for Worlds listed as Bin by most outlets but not officially confirmed.
headline: First Stand, Split 1 and Split 2 champions and MSI runners-up (2-3 vs HLE), but lost the Split 3 final 1-3 to AL, exited EWC in the QF, and has an unsettled top lane (Bin/Flandre/Wenbo).

name: G2 Esports
headline: LEC champion in all three 2026 splits (Versus, Spring, Summer; 20th LEC trophy, 3-0 over MKOI in Nice 20/09/2026) and direct Swiss Stage entry as LEC seed 1, but 2026 international form is split: First Stand finalist (1-3 vs BLG), MSI 4th (0-3 to LYON), EWC group-stage exit.

name: Karmine Corp
headline: Two-time LEC finalist (Versus, Spring) and EWC 2026 runner-up (0-3 vs Dplus KIA), regular-season 9-0 in Summer, but finished 3rd in Summer playoffs (1-3 G2, 0-3 MKOI), so LEC seed 3 starts in the Play-In (vs Cloud9, bo5); first Worlds in org history.

name: Anyone's Legend
headline: LPL Split 3 champions (3-1 over BLG) and seed 1, but no First Stand/MSI in 2026 and a 0-2 EWC quarterfinal exit; had lost six straight series to BLG before the final.

name: Invictus Gaming
headline: Seed 4 after a lower-bracket run (Split 3 LBF 2-3 to AL, then 3-1 over JDG in Regional Finals LBF); veterans TheShy, Rookie, Meiko, no 2026 international play and weak Splits 1-2.

name: LYON (Lyon Gaming)
adj_reason: Swiss and QF/SF in Allen, Texas: home crowd and no long-haul travel for LCS teams.
headline: Lock-In and Spring champions, Summer runner-up (1-3 vs TLAW), MSI 2026 3rd place, First Stand and EWC group exits; NA seed 2 directly in Swiss (Pool 3).

name: Top Esports
adj_reason: Split 3 All-Pro top laner ZUIAN refused a US visa twice (announced 06/10/2026); 369 starts after not playing competitively since Split 1 (~March). The model's TES games were mostly played with ZUIAN.
headline: Split 2 runners-up and Worlds 2025 semifinalists who qualified via Regional Finals (3-1 over IG) after a tie for 7th in Split 3; 369 replaces visa-blocked ZUIAN and coach visas are uncertain.

name: Team Liquid Alienware
adj_reason: Swiss and QF/SF in Allen, Texas: home crowd and no long-haul travel for LCS teams.
headline: LCS Summer champions (3-1 over LYON, 04/10/2026), NA seed 1 straight into the Swiss Stage (Pool 1); 6-6 and out in the Play-In at MSI 2026; missed Worlds 2025.

name: Movistar KOI
headline: Summer Split runner-up (0-3 vs G2 in Nice) after coming through the lower bracket as the lowest playoff seed (beat VIT 3-2, NAVI 3-1, KC 3-0); LEC seed 2 with direct Swiss Stage entry, but no 2026 international win (EWC groups 0-2 in series) and MSI/First Stand not attended.

name: Team Secret Whales
headline: Vietnamese LCP three-peat champions (one game dropped across three grand finals) but only 1-6 in 2026 international series (First Stand 0-2, MSI 5th-6th, EWC 13th-16th); enter Swiss directly.

name: Cloud9 KIA
adj_reason: Play-In in Los Angeles and Swiss in Allen, Texas: home crowd and no long-haul travel for LCS teams.
headline: NA seed 3 in the Play-In (vs Karmine Corp 15/10); Americas Cup and Lock-In runner-up, 3rd in Spring and Summer; first Worlds since 2023.

name: LOS (LØS / Los Grandes)
headline: CBLOL Split 2 champions (3-2 over FURIA, 10/10/2026), Brazil seed 1 directly in Swiss (Pool 2); four Worlds debutants; EWC 9th-12th as MIBR.LOS.

name: FURIA Esports
headline: Americas Cup and CBLOL Split 1 champions, Split 2 runner-up (2-3 vs LOS); Brazil seed 2 in the Play-In vs MVK (15/10); 0-2 in series at both MSI and EWC.

name: CTBC Flying Oyster
headline: Taiwanese LCP runner-up (Split 3, 0-3 to TSW) that rebuilt mid and support in May; second straight Worlds (QF in 2025); no 2026 international matches yet; enter Swiss directly.

name: MVK Esports
headline: Young all-Vietnamese LCP third seed (76 Championship Points) starting in the Play-In vs FURIA (Bo5, 15/10 23:00 UTC), with C9 and KC in the bracket; no 2026 international matches yet.
